definition: Policy approaches that focus on regulating or monitoring the computational resources (hardware, training compute) used to develop advanced AI systems.
details: Compute governance treats large-scale training compute as a useful policy lever, since it is a relatively measurable and controllable input to frontier AI development compared to algorithms or data.
story: Picture a parachute packed by a second pair of hands: nobody plans to need it, but everyone is glad it was checked. Think of it this way: Policy approaches that focus on regulating or monitoring the computational resources (hardware, training compute) used to develop advanced AI systems. And here is the clever part: Compute governance treats large-scale training compute as a useful policy lever, since it is a relatively measurable and controllable input to frontier AI development compared to algorithms or data. Caution is not the enemy of progress — it is the reason progress gets to keep going. And that is Compute Governance — the reason we can move fast without breaking things, or people.
